sonnet.problem: The right answer, the Amorite, was already named on story card 8 ("the Amorite, a people of Canaan") and story card 10 ("destroyed the Amorite"). The blank is given away and re-asks a fact already shown. The sentence also repeats "the Amorite" from verse 10 in the question stem.
sonnet.rule: No card ever gives away the answer to a choice card that comes later. ... An easy follow-up asks something new. It never re-asks the same fact. ... An answer shown on one card, right or wrong, isn't used again on a later card.
